    std::string s;

    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin >> s;

    int len = 0;
    bool inside = false;

        char ch = s[i];

            inside = true;
        } else if (ch == ')') {

            len = 0;
            inside = false;
        } else if (ch == '_') {
            if (inside) {

                len = 0;
            } else {
                if (len > 0) maxOut = std::max(maxOut, len);
                len = 0;
            }
        } else {
            len++;
        }
    }
    
    if (len > 0) maxOut = std::max(maxOut, len);
    
    std::cout << maxOut << " " << maxIn << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
